original_source: Management of Apps is partially unavailable on different platforms
symptoms: partial unavailability of Forge app lifecycle operations
failure_pattern: A misconfiguration in the Forge app management service caused the lifecycle, developer console, and deployment endpoints to become partially unavailable across multiple Atlassian platforms, leading to failures in app installation, removal, and tunneling operations.
mitigation_principle: Implement automated configuration validation; add comprehensive health checks for critical endpoints; use feature flags to isolate changes; enforce rollback procedures; monitor key metrics continuously; conduct post-incident reviews and update runbooks

symptoms: service outages across Atlassian Cloud products
failure_pattern: An outage in Amazon Web Services disrupted Atlassian’s cloud infrastructure, causing widespread service outages and preventing customers from creating support tickets. Atlassian’s teams monitored the situation, coordinated with AWS, and gradually restored functionality as AWS resolved the underlying issue.
mitigation_principle: Implement multi-cloud redundancy; add automated health checks and failover mechanisms; maintain real-time monitoring of third‑party provider status; develop and rehearse incident response playbooks; use circuit breakers to isolate failures; enforce strict SLAs with providers; establish clear communication protocols for customers
